item.title: Self-Hosted Encrypted Filesystems: gocryptfs vs encfs vs cryfs — Data Protection Guide 2026
item.description: Protecting sensitive data at rest is a fundamental requirement for any self-hosted infrastructure. Whether you are storing personal documents on a home server, managing customer data for a small business, or securing backup archives, encrypting your filesystem ensures that even if physical storage is compromised, your data remains unreadable.
